scenario.description: 學習 Linux 指令並實作自動化報表處理流程，協助行政人員高效完成跨部門專案。

setup.bash:
mkdir -p /root/confusing_project/reports/2025 /root/confusing_project/download && printf 'ID,Name,Region,Sales
1,Andy,Taipei,50000
2,Bella,Hualien,12000
3,Chris,Taichung,45000
' > /root/confusing_project/taiwan_customers.txt && echo 'Andy,180hr,28800,加班' > /root/confusing_project/part_time_weekly_report.txt && echo 'Bella,160hr,25600,未加班' >> /root/confusing_project/part_time_weekly_report.txt && echo 'Secret_Key_2026' > /root/confusing_project/download/unknown_file && mkdir -p /root/confusing_project/empty_folder && apt-get update && apt-get install -y zip && zip -qj /root/confusing_project/download/customers.zip /root/confusing_project/taiwan_customers.txt && echo '---環境初始化完成---'
